class A {
    private int a;

    public A(int a) {
        this.a = a;
    }

    void print() {
        System.out.print(a + "a");
    }
}

class B extends A {
    private int b;

    B(int a, int b) {
        super(a);
        this.b = b;
    }

    void print() {
        super.print();
        System.out.print(b + "b");
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        B obj = new B(10, 20);
        obj.print();
    }
}

#include <stdio.h>

typedef struct N {
    int v;
    struct N* a;
    struct N* b;
} N;

int c = 0;
int ans = 0;

void pst(N *n) {
    if (!n) return;
    pst(n->a);
    pst(n->b);
    if (++c == 3) ans = n->v;
}

int main() {
    N ne = {35, 0, 0};
    N nd = {64, 0, 0};
    N nc = {53, 0, 0};
    N nb = {12, &ne, &nc};
    N na = {21, &nb, &nd};

    pst(&na);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    if (n <= 1) return n;
    return c(n - 1) + c(n - 3);
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", c(5));
    return 0;
}
